title: Marquee theme (layout.yaml)
description: layout.yaml: The theme's main file. It needs a `canvas`; everything else is optional.

canvas.description: The screen the theme is made for: which way round, and how many frames a second.

styles.description: Named styles, which widgets and `when` rules use by name.

background.description: Layers drawn behind the widgets, first at the bottom: up to 16, at most 4 of them shaders and 2 videos.

widgets.description: What's drawn on the screen, in order, so later widgets cover earlier ones. Up to 2000 in all, counting the ones in groups.

ring.description: What the screen's LED ring shows. Left out, the ring is a soft warm white at 40%.

color.description: A quoted hex color: "#RGB", "#RRGGBB" or "#RRGGBBAA", where AA is the alpha, or "transparent". Quote it: an unquoted # starts a YAML comment.

paint.description: A color, or a gradient: { linear: ["#000000", "#1E2A44"], angle: 90 } or { radial: ["#1E2A44", "#000000"] }.

canvas.description: Canvas: The screen the theme is made for. A theme fits both ways up of its orientation.

orientation.description: How the screen is mounted: landscape is 1920×480, portrait 480×1920.

style.description: Styles: How a widget looks. A style is named in `styles:`, or written in place as a widget's or rule's `style:`. A group passes its text keys (font, size, weight, color, align, letter_spacing, line_height, wrap) down to its children; the others stay with its box.

extends.description: Another named style to start from; keys set here override it.

font.description: A font installed on this PC, by name, or a .ttf, .otf or .ttc file in the theme folder. Inter is built in.

weight.description: How heavy text is: 100 to 900, or a name (light 300 to bold 700).

color.description: The text's color, and the filled part of a bar, gauge or graph line when `fill` or `stroke` doesn't set one.

fill.description: The background of a text, value, image or group box. On a bar or gauge, the filled part (the style's color when left out); on a graph, the area under the line.

track.description: The empty part of a bar or gauge, and the background behind a graph.

stroke.description: An outline round a box or bar, a graph's line, and the ends of a gauge's arc (its cap).

pulse.description: Makes the opacity or the glow beat steadily.

opacity.description: How solid the whole widget is: 0 hides it, 1 is fully solid.

radius.description: Rounds the corners of a box, a bar, a graph's background and what a group or image clips to.

padding.description: Space between a text or value widget's box and its text.

align.description: Where each line of text sits across its box. The lines together are always centred from top to bottom.

blend.description: How the whole widget mixes with what's under it, as a background layer's blend does. A group's children blend with it, as one.

letter_spacing.description: Space added between the characters of text; below 0 draws them closer.

line_height.description: How far apart the lines of text are, as a multiple of the text's size.

wrap.description: Breaks text too wide for its box onto more lines, at spaces. Without it, such text draws on one line past its box. A line break starts a new line either way.

style.stroke.description: Stroke: A line: the outline drawn just inside a box, a graph's line, or the ends of a gauge's arc.

width.description: How thick the line is; 0 draws none. A graph's line is 2 px when this is left out.

color.description: The line's color or gradient. A box has no outline without it; a graph's line uses the style's color.

cap.description: How the ends of a gauge's arc and a graph's line are drawn. A graph's line is round when this is left out.

style.shadow.description: Shadow: A copy of the text drawn under it, offset and softened.

color.description: The shadow's color. There is no shadow without it.

x.description: How far right the shadow sits; negative moves it left.

y.description: How far down the shadow sits; negative moves it up.

blur.description: How soft the shadow is; 0 is sharp.

style.glow.description: Glow: A blurred copy of the text drawn behind it.

color.description: The glow's color. There is no glow without it.

style.pulse.description: Pulse: A steady beat: the opacity or the glow eases from max down to min and back, once each period.

property.description: What beats: the widget's opacity, or its glow's radius.

min.description: The low point, as a fraction of the normal opacity or glow.

max.description: The high point, as a fraction of the normal opacity or glow.

when.description: When rules: Each rule has one condition and a style to layer on while it holds. Every matching rule applies, in order. Above, below and equals compare the widget's `source`; a text widget's stale also matches while any value in its text is missing.

above.description: Matches while the widget's source is above this number.

below.description: Matches while the widget's source is below this number.

equals.description: Matches while the widget's source is this number or this text.

stale.description: Matches while the widget's source has no fresh value. It only takes true.

style.description: The style to layer on: a style's name, or a style written in place.

ring.description: LED ring: What the screen's ring of 60 LEDs shows. A key left out takes the default below, so `ring: { color: "#3A7BFF" }` shows that blue, static, at full brightness. `ring:` in config.yaml overrides it.

color.description: The LEDs' color. An alpha byte dims it.

effect.description: static is the color on every LED, breathe fades it in and out, spin sends a bright segment round the ring, and rainbow turns the hues round it, ignoring color.

speed.description: How fast the effect runs: 2 is twice as fast.

source.description: What the ring's `when` rules compare: a sensor key or an expression.

when.description: Changes to make while a condition holds. Every matching rule applies, in order.

ring.when.description: Ring when rules: Each rule has one condition, which compares the ring's `source`, and changes at least one of color, effect, speed and brightness while it holds. A later rule wins for each key it sets.

above.description: Matches while the ring's source is above this number.

below.description: Matches while the ring's source is below this number.

equals.description: Matches while the ring's source is this number or this text.

stale.description: Matches while the ring's source has no fresh value. It only takes true.

color.description: The LEDs' color. An alpha byte dims it.

effect.description: static is the color on every LED, breathe fades it in and out, spin sends a bright segment round the ring, and rainbow turns the hues round it, ignoring color.

speed.description: How fast the effect runs: 2 is twice as fast.

gradient.description: A paint is a color or a gradient. A gradient is a mapping with `linear:` or `radial:` and two or more colors, and goes wherever a key takes a paint: `fill`, `track`, a stroke's `color` or a fill layer.

gradient.linear.description: Linear gradient: Colors spread evenly in a straight line across the area.

linear.description: The colors, from the start of the line to its end.

angle.description: The line's direction, clockwise: 0 runs left to right, 90 top to bottom.

gradient.radial.description: Radial gradient: Colors spread evenly from the centre of the area outwards.

radial.description: The colors, from the centre out to half the area's longer side.

layer.description: Each entry of `background:` is one layer, chosen by which of `fill`, `image`, `shader` or `video` it has. Layers cover the whole canvas and are drawn in order, the first at the bottom.

layer.fill.description: Fill layer: A color or gradient.

opacity.description: How solid the layer is: 0 hides it, 1 is fully solid.

blend.description: How the layer mixes with the layers under it.

hidden.description: Leaves the layer off the screen; `marquee validate` still checks it.

locked.description: Stops the theme editor changing the layer. The screen ignores it.

layer.image.description: Image layer: A picture from the theme folder.

image.description: The image file, relative to the theme folder: PNG, JPEG, WebP or another format Skia reads.

fit.description: How the picture fills its box: cover crops to fill it, contain fits inside it, stretch distorts to fill it, and none keeps its own size, centred.

opacity.description: How solid the layer is: 0 hides it, 1 is fully solid.

blend.description: How the layer mixes with the layers under it.

hidden.description: Leaves the layer off the screen; `marquee validate` still checks it.

locked.description: Stops the theme editor changing the layer. The screen ignores it.

layer.shader.description: Shader layer: An SkSL shader that paints the canvas each frame. Marquee sets its `time`, `day` and `resolution` uniforms.

shader.description: The shader file (.sksl), relative to the theme folder.

uniforms.description: Binds the shader's other uniforms to numbers or expressions, one per component (up to 16). A missing or stale value is 0.

scale.description: Renders the shader at this fraction of the canvas size and stretches it up, which costs far less.

opacity.description: How solid the layer is: 0 hides it, 1 is fully solid.

blend.description: How the layer mixes with the layers under it.

hidden.description: Leaves the layer off the screen; `marquee validate` still checks it.

locked.description: Stops the theme editor changing the layer. The screen ignores it.

layer.video.description: Video layer: A clip from the theme folder, played over and over.

video.description: The clip, relative to the theme folder.

fit.description: How the picture fills its box: cover crops to fill it, contain fits inside it, stretch distorts to fill it, and none keeps its own size, centred.

opacity.description: How solid the layer is: 0 hides it, 1 is fully solid.

blend.description: How the layer mixes with the layers under it.

hidden.description: Leaves the layer off the screen; `marquee validate` still checks it.

locked.description: Stops the theme editor changing the layer. The screen ignores it.

widget.description: Each entry of `widgets:`, and of a group's `children:`, is one widget, chosen by its `type`.

type.description: What kind of widget this is.

widget.text.description: Text: Text, which can show values. A line break (`\n` in double quotes, or a `|` block) starts a new line, and with the style's `wrap` a line too wide for the box breaks at spaces. Without a `source`, its `when` rules can only use `stale`, which matches while any value in the text is missing.

type.description: What kind of widget this is.

at.description: Where the widget's top-left corner goes, relative to the canvas or its group.

size.description: The widget's width and height, each at least 1.

source.description: The value the widget shows, and what its `when` rules compare: a sensor key such as cpu.temp, or an expression. Value, bar, gauge and graph widgets need one.

style.description: How the widget looks: a style's name from `styles:`, or a style written in place.

when.description: Styles to layer on while a condition holds, in order: every rule that matches applies, so a later one wins.

smooth.description: Eases a value, bar or gauge to a new number over this long; 0 jumps straight there.

rotate.description: Turns the widget clockwise about its own centre. A group's children turn with it.

hidden.description: Leaves the widget off the screen; `marquee validate` still checks it. A hidden group hides its children.

locked.description: Stops the theme editor moving or resizing the widget with the mouse. The screen ignores it.

text.description: The text. {cpu.temp} shows a value, {cpu.temp:0.0} formats it and {gpu.vram_used|bytes} uses a helper.

widget.value.description: Value: One value as text, laid out as a text widget's is. A missing or stale value shows as —.

type.description: What kind of widget this is.

at.description: Where the widget's top-left corner goes, relative to the canvas or its group.

size.description: The widget's width and height, each at least 1.

source.description: The value to show: a sensor key such as cpu.temp, or an expression.

style.description: How the widget looks: a style's name from `styles:`, or a style written in place.

when.description: Styles to layer on while a condition holds, in order: every rule that matches applies, so a later one wins.

smooth.description: Eases a value, bar or gauge to a new number over this long; 0 jumps straight there.

rotate.description: Turns the widget clockwise about its own centre. A group's children turn with it.

hidden.description: Leaves the widget off the screen; `marquee validate` still checks it. A hidden group hides its children.

locked.description: Stops the theme editor moving or resizing the widget with the mouse. The screen ignores it.

format.description: How to write the value: a .NET format such as "{0:0.0}°C", or duration or bytes. Left out, a number shows up to two decimals.

widget.bar.description: Bar: A bar filled in proportion to a value: `track` paints the empty part, `fill` (or the style's color) the full part.

type.description: What kind of widget this is.

at.description: Where the widget's top-left corner goes, relative to the canvas or its group.

size.description: The widget's width and height, each at least 1.

source.description: The value that fills the bar: a sensor key or an expression.

style.description: How the widget looks: a style's name from `styles:`, or a style written in place.

when.description: Styles to layer on while a condition holds, in order: every rule that matches applies, so a later one wins.

smooth.description: Eases a value, bar or gauge to a new number over this long; 0 jumps straight there.

rotate.description: Turns the widget clockwise about its own centre. A group's children turn with it.

hidden.description: Leaves the widget off the screen; `marquee validate` still checks it. A hidden group hides its children.

locked.description: Stops the theme editor moving or resizing the widget with the mouse. The screen ignores it.

min.description: The value at which the bar is empty.

max.description: The value at which the bar is full. It must be more than min.

direction.description: Which way it fills: horizontal fills left to right, vertical bottom to top.

widget.gauge.description: Gauge: An arc filled in proportion to a value, in the largest square that fits its box. Angles are clockwise from 3 o'clock; the default arc opens at the bottom.

type.description: What kind of widget this is.

at.description: Where the widget's top-left corner goes, relative to the canvas or its group.

size.description: The widget's width and height, each at least 1.

source.description: The value that fills the arc: a sensor key or an expression.

style.description: How the widget looks: a style's name from `styles:`, or a style written in place.

when.description: Styles to layer on while a condition holds, in order: every rule that matches applies, so a later one wins.

smooth.description: Eases a value, bar or gauge to a new number over this long; 0 jumps straight there.

rotate.description: Turns the widget clockwise about its own centre. A group's children turn with it.

hidden.description: Leaves the widget off the screen; `marquee validate` still checks it. A hidden group hides its children.

locked.description: Stops the theme editor moving or resizing the widget with the mouse. The screen ignores it.

min.description: The value at which the arc is empty.

max.description: The value at which the arc is full. It must be more than min.

sweep.description: How far the arc runs from its start; negative runs anticlockwise. It can't be 0.

widget.graph.description: Graph: A line of a sensor's recent values, newest at the right. The stroke draws the line, `fill` the area under it and `track` the background.

type.description: What kind of widget this is.

at.description: Where the widget's top-left corner goes, relative to the canvas or its group.

size.description: The widget's width and height, each at least 1.

source.description: The sensor whose history is drawn: one key, such as gpu.load, not an expression.

style.description: How the widget looks: a style's name from `styles:`, or a style written in place.

when.description: Styles to layer on while a condition holds, in order: every rule that matches applies, so a later one wins.

smooth.description: Eases a value, bar or gauge to a new number over this long; 0 jumps straight there.

hidden.description: Leaves the widget off the screen; `marquee validate` still checks it. A hidden group hides its children.

locked.description: Stops the theme editor moving or resizing the widget with the mouse. The screen ignores it.

min.description: The value at the bottom. Left out, the scale fits the values shown.

max.description: The value at the top; more than min if both are set. Left out, the scale fits the values shown.

points.description: How many recent values span the width, one per sensor update.

widget.image.description: Image: A picture from the theme folder, over the style's `fill` and under its stroke, clipped to the box.

widget.group.description: Group: A box that holds other widgets. Its children are placed from its top-left corner, clipped to it, and take on its text style. Groups nest up to 16 deep.
